tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a header metadata field not represented as a leaf element in the MeF schema for Schedule 3.

taxpayer_name.rationale: Taxpayer name is a header metadata field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule 3 MeF schema.

ssn.rationale: SSN is a header metadata field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule 3 MeF schema.

foreign_tax_credit.rationale: ForeignTaxCreditAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 1, the foreign tax credit amount.

child_dependent_care_credit.rationale: CreditForChildAndDepdCareAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 2, the child and dependent care credit.

education_credits.rationale: EducationCreditAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 3, the education credits amount.

retirement_savings_credit.rationale: RtrSavingsContributionsCrAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 4, the retirement savings contributions credit.

residential_clean_energy_credit.rationale: ResidentialCleanEnergyCrAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 5a, the residential clean energy credit.

energy_efficient_home_improvement_credit.rationale: EgyEffcntHmImprvCrAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 5b, the energy efficient home improvement credit.

other_nonrefundable_credits_description.rationale: OtherNonrefundableCreditsTxt is the text/label field within OtherNonrefundableCreditsGrp, corresponding to the write-in description for other nonrefundable credits.

other_nonrefundable_credits.rationale: TotOthNonrefundableCreditsAmt represents the aggregate total of other nonrefundable credits written in on the line 6 series, matching the blueprint field's description.

total_nonrefundable_credits.rationale: TotalNonrefundableCreditsAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 8, the total nonrefundable credits carried to Form 1040.

part_i_writeins.rationale: Blueprint bundles an array of individual write-in entries; canonical schema represents these as repeating OtherNonrefundableCreditsGrp elements each containing OtherNonrefundableCreditsTxt and OtherNonrefundableCreditsAmt — blueprint should be refactored into a repeating group structure matching OtherNonrefundableCreditsGrp.

net_premium_tax_credit.rationale: ReconciledPremiumTaxCreditAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 9, the net premium tax credit from Form 8962.

amount_paid_with_extension.rationale: RequestForExtensionAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 10, the amount paid with a request for extension.

excess_social_security_tax_withheld.rationale: ExcessSocSecAndTier1RRTATaxAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 11, the excess social security and tier 1 RRTA tax withheld.

other_payments_refundable_credits_descri.rationale: OtherRefundableCrTxt is the text/label field within OtherRefundableCreditsGrp, corresponding to the write-in description for other payments and refundable credits.

other_payments_refundable_credits.rationale: TotalOtherRefundableCreditsAmt represents the aggregate total of other refundable credits/payments on the line 13 series write-ins.

total_other_payments_refundable_credits.rationale: TotalOtherPaymentsRfdblCrAmt directly corresponds to Schedule 3 Line 15, the total other payments and refundable credits carried to Form 1040.

part_ii_writeins.rationale: Blueprint bundles an array of individual write-in entries; canonical schema represents these as repeating OtherRefundableCreditsGrp elements each containing OtherRefundableCrCd, OtherRefundableCrTxt, and OtherRefundableCreditsAmt — blueprint should be refactored into a repeating group structure matching OtherRefundableCreditsGrp.
